title: Modal verbs
outcome: Я могу говорить о правилах, обязанностях и советах.
idea: Обязанность, совет и «не обязательно»: must, have to, should, don’t have to.

practice: Правила на работе и советы другу.

mistakes: You don’t have to do it.

cols.label: must / have to — надо
examples: I have to work on Saturday.

cols.label: don’t have to — не обязательно
examples: I don’t have to get up early on Sunday.

visual.note: mustn’t = нельзя: You mustn’t smoke here. А don’t have to = можно не делать.

title: Expressing complex ideas
outcome: Я могу связно объяснять сложные мысли.
idea: Как связывать мысли в длинные точные предложения вместо коротких фраз.
leadIn: What is something complex that you understand well?
practice: Объяснить сложную тему из своей жизни или работы.
speaking: Explain a complex topic from your work in 2 minutes.

warmup: What is something complex that you understand well?

pairs: It’s not only cheap but also fast.
I like cities. My sister likes villages.
I like cities, whereas my sister prefers villages.
Prices went up. People buy less.
Prices went up, which means that people buy less.
I moved. I wanted a change.
The reason why I moved is that I wanted a change.
visual.note: Одна длинная связная мысль звучит увереннее, чем три коротких.

items.q: I love the city, ___ my husband prefers the countryside.
The reason ___ I left is that I needed a challenge.
Remote work saves time. It can feel lonely.
items.a: Remote work saves time, whereas it can feel lonely.

items.q: AI is fast. It is accurate.
items.a: AI is not only fast but also accurate.

items.q: I changed jobs. I wanted more freedom.
items.a: The reason why I changed jobs is that I wanted more freedom.

speak.q: Explain a complex topic from your work in 2 minutes.
speak.hint: The reason why… which means that… whereas…

speak.hint: not only… but also… · whereas…
